name: GenericAgent
description: Minimal self-evolving agent of about 3K lines that controls the local system and saves each solved task as a reusable skill.
whatItDoes: Gives an LLM system-level control of a computer to complete tasks, then stores the successful path as a skill so repeated work gets faster. Suited to individuals who want a small agent they can read and grow.
howItWorks: Nine atomic tools and an agent loop of roughly 100 lines form the core. Skills accumulate into a personal skill tree instead of being preloaded. It is used through a terminal UI or a Streamlit web UI, with keys kept in a local mykey.py file.
